title: Correctness Forensics for Batch Speculative Decoding: Diagnosing the Ragged Tensor Problem
abstract: arXiv:2510.22876v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Inference optimizations are routinely evaluated by throughput alone, without verifying output correctness. We conduct a forensic analysis of batch speculative decoding and find that several widely-used implementations silently produce corrupted outputs (repetitive tokens,  symbols) while reporting competitive speed; failures invisible to metrics like ROUGE. We trace the root cause to the ragged tensor problem: variable token acceptance desynchronizes position IDs, attention masks, and KV-cache across a batch. We formalize the synchronization invariants (rectangular alignment and position-ID contiguity) that valid batched inference must preserve and show that maintaining them incurs superlinear alignment overhead under contiguous layouts. translated_title: 批量投机解码的正确性取证：诊断参差张量问题
translated_abstract: 推理优化通常仅通过吞吐量进行评估，而未验证输出的正确性。我们对批量投机解码进行了取证分析，发现几种广泛使用的实现在报告出具有竞争力的速度的同时，悄然产生损坏的输出（重复的标记、异常符号），这类故障对于ROUGE等评估指标是不可见的。我们将根本原因追溯到参差张量问题：批次内各序列的可变标记接受率导致位置ID、注意力掩码和KV缓存失去同步。我们形式化了有效批量推理必须保持的同步不变量（矩形对齐和位置ID连续性），并证明在连续布局下维持这些不变量会产生超线性的对齐开销。EQSPEC无需自定义内核即可强制执行这些不变量；EXSPEC则通过调度等长序列来绕过重新对齐。在SpecBench上跨三个模型家族的实验中，EXSPEC达到了3倍吞吐量。
tldr: 本文取证发现多个主流批量投机解码实现会悄然产生损坏输出，根源是可变标记接受导致的参差张量同步问题，并提出EQSPEC与EXSPEC两种方法，在不牺牲正确性的前提下实现最高3倍的吞吐量提升。
en_tdlr: This paper forensically reveals that widely-used batch speculative decoding implementations silently produce corrupted outputs due to the ragged tensor synchronization problem, and proposes EQSPEC and EXSPEC to achieve up to 3x throughput without sacrificing correctness.
